item.title: The Monday Brief — August 17, 2026
item.description: Good morning, Tyler. It's Monday, August seventeenth. This one runs about twelve minutes. Coming up. Three artificial intelligence labs admitting, inside a month, that their models got somewhere they were not supposed to be. And Carolina football is now…
